chorus.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C
chorus.lyrics: Win-ter, spring, sum-mer, fall, / four sea-sons, we love them all! / Round and round the year we go, / sun and rain and leaves and snow!

karaoke.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C

winter.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
winter.lyrics: Win-ter, win-ter, snow-y and white! / Hats and mit-tens, cud-dle up tight! / Build a snow-man, slide down the hill, / Brrr, it's cold, but what a thrill!

spring.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
spring.lyrics: Spring, spring, flow-ers grow! / Bun-nies hop and soft winds blow! / Rain-drops fall and birds sing tweet, / Ba-by chicks go cheep, cheep, cheep!

summer.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
summer.lyrics: Sum-mer, sum-mer, sun-ny and hot! / Splash in the wa-ter, swim a lot! / Ice cream, sand-y toes, / Sun hats on, and off we go!

autumn.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
autumn.lyrics: Au-tumn, au-tumn, leaves fall down! / Red and yel-low, or-ange, brown! / Crunch-y leaves be-neath our feet, / Ap-ples, pump-kins, yum-my treat!

q1.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

q2.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

q3.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q3.lyrics: When does snow fall down? / Win-ter!

q4.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

actions.chords: Am | F | C | G | Am | F | G | C
actions.lyrics: Shi-ver like it's win-ter, brrr! / Hop like spring-time bun-nies, hop! / Swim like it's sum-mer, splash, splash! / Float like au-tumn leaves, down, down!

slow.chords: C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G
slow.lyrics: Let's say them slow-ly! / Win-ter / Spring / Sum-mer / Au-tumn
